title: Wildfire
tldr: Check evacuation notices for your address. Leave promptly when ordered, using the current official route; do not delay for possessions. If a fire threatens your escape or you are trapped, call emergency services with your precise location.
steps: Use fire agency and emergency management alerts rather than old perimeter maps.
Take essential medicines, identification, keys and phone power without delaying departure.
Smoke and closures can change quickly; do not drive into heavy smoke or flames.
Tell an out-of-area contact where you are going and follow shelter instructions.
next: Return only when reentry is allowed. Check for damaged utilities, hot debris and continuing smoke.
watch: A smoke-control room cannot protect you from a fire approaching the building.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: Leave before the only usable route is threatened. If no official update is reachable, act on visible nearby fire, rapidly worsening conditions and verified local information rather than waiting for an order. Do not drive into smoke with unknown visibility or through flames.
household: Account for children, older people, pets and anyone who needs assistance before moving. Keep shoes, medicines and a torch in the shelter area. Decide who helps whom and who carries the essential supplies; do not send a lone child to retrieve items.
pack_now: Keep essential medicines, drinking water, a battery light, shoes, phone power and a written contact card within reach. Adapt the load to the hazard and the people with you; do not delay escape to collect equipment.
